rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming with the user, despite the user initially asking about splitting payment and only conditionally considering cancellation. This violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The agent also skipped attempting supported alternatives (split payment determination, most expensive item removal, switching to cheaper options) and provided a refund timeline not supported by tool outputs. While the agent appeared to look up the user/order (authentication likely adequate), the premature cancellation, incorrect reason (“ordered by mistake”), lack of confirmation, and unsupported statements mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
